text_block_list.text: A few days after the Selection Race—

I happened upon the sisters, Biwa Hayahide and Narita Brian,
surrounded by a crowd of Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text: Please! Just hear me out, that's all I ask!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... What a drag.
I haven't even run my Selection Race yet.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do not dismiss them so hastily. Receiving scout offers before your debut
is proof of how high their expectations are for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Like I care...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I know I can guide you all the way to the Triple Crown!
My passion won't lose to anyone! Please, Brian the "Monster"!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Our support system is top-notch! What do you say, Brian?!
We will prioritize your natural physical gifts and your personal wishes above all!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and Biwa Hayahide, you're welcome to join as well!
Would you consider our team? Sisters pushing each other to new heights—we'd love that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I appreciate the offer, but I have yet to make my decision.
I must respectfully decline.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well then. ...Do your best with the rest, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Hey! If you're bailing, take these guys with—!

Biwa Hayahide offered a smile and walked away—
but behind that smile, there seemed to be a faint shadow of melancholy.
Concerned, I decided to follow after her...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It's you.
Come to think of it, you were watching us from a distance earlier, weren't you—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Did you follow me here?
...Heh, between this and the glasses, you truly are quite the soft touch.

text_block_list.name: Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, wait up! Pleeaaase!!
*pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Come on, hurry up!
The goal is just around the corner~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...She is my pride and joy.
She may seem blunt and standoffish now, but she is an honest, adorable girl at heart.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...When we were little, we used to race in parks just like this every single day.
Back then, I was the faster one, and she'd often cry because she hated losing so much.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even so... she always told me, "Running with you is fun," and "I love racing!"
She was always chasing after my back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I only wish I could have remained that "proud big sister" forever.
choice_data_list: And you feel you aren't anymore...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Since those days, we have always aspired to run in the Twinkle Series.
Brian and I, together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because I was always by her side... I could feel it firsthand.
The creeping realization of how truly exceptional my sister... "Narita Brian" was becoming.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Her physical abilities, in particular, outstripped mine in the blink of an eye.
Power, speed, stamina... she excels beyond measure in every single metric.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Anyone can see that Brian is... "extraordinary."
In time, she will surely become a "Monster" on par with President Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—That is why I required a weapon of my own.
A weapon entirely different from Brian's.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If raw talent falls short, compensate with meticulously formulated strategy.
If training time is finite, maximize its efficiency to the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just as one constructs a hypothesis, builds the formula, and derives the solution...
I will conquer my races with my very own "Formula for Victory"!
choice_data_list: So that's the weapon you forged...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, though it is still very much a work in progress.
I have not yet grown into someone worthy of standing alongside Brian as an equal.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, I don't wanna anymore~...
I wanna go super-duper fast like big sis, tooooo...

text_block_list.name: Big Sister
text_block_list.text:
Aw, don't cry! There, there.
Look, big sis will show you the trick to it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...We made a promise.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She might not even remember it anymore... but that's fine.
As her sister, and as a fellow horsegirl, someday without fail—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: On the grand stage of the Twinkle Series, I will run the ultimate race against my sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And with my perfected "Formula for Victory"...
I will show her that I can defeat Brian!

Biwa Hayahide, who always seemed so mysterious, cool, and collected,
had such burning passion hidden deep within her heart.

And the theory-driven racing she described...
It felt like I had just glimpsed a brand-new frontier of potential for horsegirls...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What did you just say?
choice_data_list: I want to build your "Formula for Victory" together!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
D-Does that mean...!?
No, but wait, you haven't made up your mind yet...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: First and foremost... Are you really sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ......Are you sure you want 'the older sister'?
choice_data_list: I want to be your Trainer!
Please let me be your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This notebook contains numerous theories currently under construction.
Including, of course, the "Formula for Victory."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems today,
there is one crucial element that must be added.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I shall inscribe your name on the very first page.
And so, I signed a contract to become Biwa Hayahide's Trainer.

Together with this composed, brilliant girl, I would formulate the ultimate "Formula for Victory"—
and I resolved then and there to lead her to triumph.
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm...? What's this? I'm hearing Brian's name
mentioned even more frequently than usual...?)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, so it's really true!?
About Brian-senpai running in the Sprout Memorial...!?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, looks pretty certain!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(The Sprout Memorial...! That exhibition race where only the most
highly anticipated runners up through the Junior Class earn a spot...?!)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, that's insane...! A pre-debut horsegirl getting chosen?
Isn't that completely unprecedented!?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Brian-senpai really is built different, huh~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...You keep pulling further and further ahead, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Which is precisely why............!!
